about: データに入っている、自治体Watch が調べて書いた語・注記の英訳（作業単位7。2026-10-24）。キーは日本語の原文そのまま。値が null のものは訳さず日本語のまま出す（団体の名前など）。英語版で、表に無い原文を出そうとするとビルドが止まる（lib/data-text.ts）。原文の URL は英訳にもそのまま入れる

minutes_format.全文検索テキスト（＋速報版の告知）: Full-text search (plus notices of provisional versions)
minutes_format.全文検索テキスト（本会議。委員会は「会議記録」）: Full-text search (plenary sessions; committees publish meeting records)

minutes_format.本会議・委員会ともNotes型会議録検索: Notes-based minutes search for both plenary sessions and committees
minutes_format.検索システム＋本会議PDF＋委員会HTML: Search system + plenary PDFs + committee HTML
minutes_format.HTML会議録（号単位の全文）＋キーワード検索: HTML minutes (full text by issue) + keyword search

chief_note.2026-08-30執行の再選。得票数・投票率・当日有権者数は岐阜新聞の開票記事: Re-elected in the election held on 30 August 2026. Votes received, voter turnout and the number of registered voters on election day are from the Gifu Shimbun article on the count (https://www.gifu-np.co.jp/articles/-/762103). The runner-up, 益田大輔, received 21,216 votes. Times elected (2) is from the Gifu Prefectural Election Administration Commission's list of terms of office (as of 31 August 2026).
chief_note.4期目（通算当選5回）。回は自治総研定義どおり当選回数を格納: Fourth term (elected five times in total). Times elected is recorded as the number of times elected, as defined by the Japan Research Institute for Local Government.
chief_note.可児市長選(2026-10-18執行)。得票数は確定開票速報(https://w: Kani City mayoral election (held on 18 October 2026). Votes received are from the final count results (https://www.city.kani.lg.jp/27592.htm); the 76,253 registered voters on election day, the 25,910 voters and the 33.98% turnout are from the final voting status (https://www.city.kani.lg.jp/27597.htm). The absolute vote share is calculated as votes received ÷ registered voters on election day. The runner-up, 平田亮, received 9,538 votes. Times elected (5) is from the Gifu Shimbun's report of a fifth win.
chief_note.2026-06-07執行の再選。得票数・投票率は岐阜放送の記事（https://: Re-elected in the election held on 7 June 2026. Votes received and voter turnout are from a Gifu Broadcasting article (https://www.zf-web.com/news/2026/06/07/215006.html). The number of registered voters on election day has not been confirmed from a primary source, so the absolute vote share is not given either. Times elected (2) is from the Gifu Prefectural Election Administration Commission's list of terms of office (as of 31 August 2026).
chief_note.投票は行われましたが（投票率52.26%）、得票数と党派は確認できていません: Voting took place (turnout 52.26%), but the votes received and party affiliation have not been confirmed.
chief_note.理由：大野町公式サイトに候補者別の開票結果が見当たらないため: Reason: the official Ono Town website does not show the count results by candidate.
chief_note.得票数が分からないため、絶対得票率も算出できません: As the votes received are not known, the absolute vote share cannot be calculated.
chief_note.2026年9月11日に町公式サイトを確認しましたが、候補者別の結果は掲載されてい: The town's official website was checked on 11 September 2026, but results by candidate were not published.
chief_note.2026-08-04告示の無投票再選。当選年月日は投票予定日（岐阜県選管の令和8: Re-elected unopposed after the election was announced on 4 August 2026. The election date is the scheduled polling day (from the Gifu Prefectural Election Administration Commission's schedule of municipal elections in 2026, following the way the Japan Research Institute for Local Government records unopposed elections). Times elected (2) is from the Gifu Prefectural Election Administration Commission's list of terms of office (as of 31 August 2026).
chief_note.得票数は按分票（公選法68条の2。同姓「桂川」2名の氏のみ記載票を得票数比で按分: Votes received include fractions because of proportional allocation (Article 68-2 of the Public Offices Election Act: ballots bearing only the surname 桂川, shared by two candidates, are divided in proportion to their votes). This is not an error in the data.
chief_note.得票数は報道（NHK・中日）による。投票率・当日有権者数は市公式: Votes received are from news reports (NHK and the Chunichi Shimbun). Voter turnout and the number of registered voters on election day are from the city's official figures.
chief_note.2026-02-15告示の無投票で初当選（前市長の辞職による選挙）。当選年月日は: First elected unopposed after the election was announced on 15 February 2026 (an election held because the previous mayor resigned). The election date is the scheduled polling day (following the way unopposed elections are recorded). The name is from Aichi Prefecture's list of heads of municipalities. The announcement date, scheduled polling day, new candidate, independent status and resignation are from the go2senkyo.com election page (https://go2senkyo.com/local/senkyo/26565) (based on news reports).
chief_note.投票率は愛知県選管の情報。当日有権者数を確認できなかったため、絶対得票率は算出し: Voter turnout is from the Aichi Prefectural Election Administration Commission. The number of registered voters on election day could not be confirmed, so the absolute vote share has not been calculated.
chief_note.得票数・投票率は報道（NHK・中日）による。町公式の結果ページは確認できなかった: Votes received and voter turnout are from news reports (NHK and the Chunichi Shimbun). The town's official results page could not be found. The number of registered voters on election day could not be confirmed either, so the absolute vote share has not been calculated.
chief_note.2026-09-13執行。2025-07-27に当選した前町長の辞職（2026-: Held on 13 September 2026, following the resignation (submitted on 4 August 2026) of the previous mayor, who had been elected on 27 July 2025. chief_note.得票数は報道（朝日・中日・日経）による。投票率・当日有権者数は市公式: Votes received are from news reports (Asahi Shimbun, Chunichi Shimbun and Nikkei). Voter turnout and the number of registered voters on election day are from the city's official figures.
chief_note.回は自治総研定義の当選回数（現データ7回に1回を加算）。市の「第6回熊野市長選挙: Times elected is the number of times elected as defined by the Japan Research Institute for Local Government (one added to the seven in the previous data). The city's "6th Kumano mayoral election" is the number of the election, not the number of times elected. The number of registered voters on election day is not given on the city's results page and could not be confirmed, so the absolute vote share has not been calculated.
chief_note.無投票は報道（NHK）による。町公式の結果ページは未確認: The unopposed result is from a news report (NHK). The town's official results page has not been confirmed.
